title: Analysis code and preserved inputs for Leiomyosarcoma-Enriched Myogenic Axis in Public Sarcoma Cohorts

creators.name: Roh, Sanghyun
creators.affiliation: Department of Medical Science, Soonchunhyang University, Republic of Korea

description:
Five sequential R scripts and preserved inputs for the revised analysis of a leiomyosarcoma-enriched myogenic axis in nine public GEO cohorts and TCGA-SARC. Includes the S1 Data workbook, fixed analysis settings, archived gene sets and ten binary parts reconstructing nine historical prepared GEO expression matrices. TCGA files are retrieved from a checksum-verified, fixed cBioPortal datahub commit. The separate online RMA reconstruction is retained as a sensitivity analysis. Historical normalization and annotation versions are incompletely documented; connected-record groups are not confirmed unique patients. MIT applies to the original code and documentation; third-party data retain their original terms as described in DATA_SOURCES.md.

This research was supported by the development of a real-world big data-based clinic-genomic information management system for sarcoma through the National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF), funded by the Ministry of Education (RS-2024-00349335), awarded to J.-A.G. This research was supported by the Soonchunhyang University Research Fund. The funders had no role in study design, data collection and analysis, decision to publish, or preparation of the manuscript.
